No Impact Man

Sep 12, 2009 • Janice Cotcher

Colin Beavan decided to completely eliminate his personal impact on the environment for the next year: eating vegetarian, buying only local food, no electricity, no cars, buses, or airplanes, no toxic cleaning products, no material consumption, and no garbage. No problem for Colin but his wife Michelle struggles adjusting to their radical lifestyle change and the No Impact Project has an unforeseen impact of its own.
